Training

Training courses

HGV licence routes, Driver CPC and further courses. Each course has its own page and shows the bases that offer it.

HGV training

  • Rigid lorries

    Category C

    Practical training for rigid goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, for drivers moving up from a car licence.

    Offered at Bristol, Taunton and Exeter

    Enquire about this course

  • Articulated and drawbar

    Category C+E

    Trailer training for drivers who already hold Category C and need the articulated or drawbar entitlement.

    Offered at Bristol and Exeter

    Enquire about this course

  • Professional drivers

    Driver CPC

    Periodic training for professional drivers who need hours towards a Driver Qualification Card.

    Offered at Bristol and Taunton

    Enquire about this course
